Accomplished technology consultant and enterprise architect with over 12 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying resilient web, cloud-native, and cross-platform mobility platforms.

Deep domain experience across Enterprise Cloud, Distributed Systems, FinTech, and Data Compliance. Passionate about leveraging cloud-native architectures, micro-frontends, and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate business time-to-market.
